title: Church leaders: Collaboration & Sensemaking
description: Church leaders  Rebuild a well-moderated, hyper-local, embodied media culture, in three clusters.
content:
## Church leaders

Rebuild a well-moderated, hyper-local, *embodied* media culture, in three clusters. **Become the commons:** an inclusive third space (co-working, café, recreation, transit-accessible); church facilities as community information hubs; media-literacy workshops open to all; a civic-journalism initiative and youth media corps covering local events and government; a fact-check hotline; a moderated digital town hall; support — including financial — for local news outlets. **Weave the generations:** intergenerational wisdom exchange and community storytelling projects that build empathy across age and difference — with the exchange running both directions, for sometimes the word comes to the youngest in the house (Samuel under Eli, 1 Samuel 3; young Jeremiah, Jeremiah 1:6-7). **Re-root the economy** (extending Module 7's regeneration): exit-to-community investing, land trusts, micro-lending, time banking, Sabbath-economics education, simplicity and "do less" challenges, and support for members intentionally downshifting. Trust is rebuilt where information, relationship, and economics are re-localized together.
